title: Reward-Oracle MCTS for Formal Theorem Proving: Sample-Efficient Search and the Need for Kernel-Level Proof Auditing
abstract: arXiv:2608.28639v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Formal theorem proving with large language models remains challenging due to the difficulty of navigating large proof search spaces efficiently. Existing tree search approaches either feed verbose compiler error messages directly into the generation context, increasing context usage during search, or employ non-standard evaluation protocols that prevent direct comparison with established baselines. We propose a three-role Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) framework that treats the Lean 4 compiler purely as a reward oracle using compiler output as a scalar signal for UCB-guided tree updates without feeding error content into the generation context. Our framework decomposes proof search into three roles: a generator for proof attempts, a decomposer for subgoal decomposition, and a critic for subgoal quality evaluation. translated_title: 面向形式化定理证明的奖励预言机蒙特卡洛树搜索：样本高效搜索与内核级证明审计的必要性
translated_abstract: 基于大语言模型的形式化定理证明仍然具有挑战性，原因在于难以高效地导航庞大的证明搜索空间。现有的树搜索方法要么将冗长的编译器错误信息直接输入生成上下文，从而增加搜索过程中的上下文占用，要么采用非标准的评估协议，导致无法与既有基线进行直接比较。我们提出了一个三角色蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）框架，该框架将Lean 4编译器纯粹视为奖励预言机，利用编译器输出作为标量信号来驱动UCB引导的树更新，而不将错误内容输入生成上下文。我们的框架将证明搜索分解为三个角色：用于生成证明尝试的生成器、用于子目标分解的分解器，以及用于子目标质量评估的评判器。我们在涵盖竞赛数学与物理领域的4个基准（MiniF2F、PutnamBench、LeanPhysBench、PhysLean）上进行了评估。
tldr: 提出一种将Lean 4编译器仅作为标量奖励信号的三角色MCTS框架，通过避免将编译错误信息注入生成上下文实现样本高效的证明搜索，并强调了内核级证明审计的必要性。
en_tdlr: A three-role MCTS framework that treats the Lean 4 compiler purely as a scalar reward oracle achieves sample-efficient proof search without injecting error content into the generation context, highlighting the need for kernel-level proof auditing.
